Divide that by 500 and we basically have a Teapot Dome sized corruption scandal on an average day under Trump.</p><p style="margin: 0 0 20px 0;color: rgb(54,55,55);line-height: 26px;font-size: 16px;">So it’s basically day after day of scandals as big or bigger than Teapot Dome.
